lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੰਨੇ ਆਪਿ ਸੋਈ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no ma(n)ne aap soee maaneeai ||
lines.translation: Those whom You approve, are approved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: pragat purakh paravaan sabh thaaee jaaneeai ||3||
lines.translation: Such a celebrated and honored person is known everywhere. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ਸਾਹ ਸਾਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: dinas rain aaraadh samhaale saah saah ||
lines.translation: Day and night, with every breath to worship and adore the Lord

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਲੋਚਾ ਪੂਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੦੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kee lochaa poor sache paatisaah ||4||6||108||
lines.translation: - please, O True Supreme King, fulfill this, Nanak's desire. ||4||6||108||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਠਾਇ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: poor rahiaa srab thaai hamaaraa khasam soi ||
lines.translation: He, my Lord Master, is fully pervading all places.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਤੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ek saahib sir chhat doojaa naahi koi ||1||
lines.translation: He is the One Lord Master, the roof over our heads; there is no other than Him. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu raakh raakhanahaariaa ||
lines.translation: As it pleases Your Will, please save me, O Savior Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tujh bin avar na koi nadar nihaariaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Without You, my eyes see no other at all. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਾਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: pratipaale prabh aap ghat ghat saareeai ||
lines.translation: God Himself is the Cherisher; He takes care of each and every heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਪਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jis man vuthaa aap tis na visaareeai ||2||
lines.translation: That person, within whose mind You Yourself dwell, never forgets You. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਣ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo kichh kare s aap aapan bhaaniaa ||
lines.translation: He does that which is pleasing to Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: bhagataa kaa sahaaee jug jug jaaniaa ||3||
lines.translation: He is known as the help and support of His devotees, throughout the ages. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਝੂਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap jap har kaa naam kade na jhooreeai ||
lines.translation: Chanting and meditating up the Lord's Name, the mortal never comes to regret anything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਲੋਚਾ ਪੂਰੀਐ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੦੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak daras piaas lochaa pooreeai ||4||7||109||
lines.translation: O Nanak, I thirst for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; please, fulfill my desire, O Lord. ||4||7||109||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਸੋਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਗਾਫਲ ਗਹਿਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa sovahi naam visaar gaaphal gahiliaa ||
lines.translation: Why are you sleeping, and forgetting the Name, O careless and foolish mortal?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਤਂੀ ਇਤੁ ਦਰੀਆਇ ਵੰਞਨੑਿ ਵਹਦਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kita(n)ee it dareeaai va(n)njanhi vahadiaa ||1||
lines.translation: So many have been washed away and carried off by this river of life. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੋਹਿਥੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਮਨ ਚੜਿ ਲੰਘੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: bohithaRaa har charan man chaR la(n)gheeai ||
lines.translation: O mortal, get aboard the boat of the Lord's Lotus Feet, and cross over.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aath pahar gun gaai saadhoo sa(n)geeai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੋਗਹਿ ਭੋਗ ਅਨੇਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੁੰਞਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhogahi bhog anek vin naavai su(n)njiaa ||
lines.translation: You may enjoy various pleasures, but they are useless without the Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਾ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਰੁੰਨਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har kee bhagat binaa mar mar ru(n)niaa ||2||
lines.translation: Without devotion to the Lord, you shall die in sorrow, again and again. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਪੜ ਭੋਗ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਤਨਿ ਮਰਦਨ ਮਾਲਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kapaR bhog suga(n)dh tan maradan maalanaa ||
lines.translation: You may dress and eat and apply scented oils to your body,

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਤਨੁ ਛਾਰੁ ਸਰਪਰ ਚਾਲਣਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: bin simaran tan chhaar sarapar chaalanaa ||3||
lines.translation: but without the meditative remembrance of the Lord, your body shall surely turn to dust, and you shall have to depart. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਪੇਖਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa bikham sa(n)saar viralai pekhiaa ||
lines.translation: How very treacherous is this world-ocean; how very few realize this!

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੂਟਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਖਿਆ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: chhootan har kee saran lekh naanak lekhiaa ||4||8||110||
lines.translation: Salvation rests in the Lord's Sanctuary; O Nanak, this is your pre-ordained destiny. ||4||8||110||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਗਰਬੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: koi na kis hee sa(n)g kaahe garabeeai ||
lines.translation: No one is anyone's companion; why take any pride in others?

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰਬੀਐ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ek naam aadhaar bhaujal tarabeeai ||1||
lines.translation: With the Support of the One Name, this terrible world-ocean is crossed over. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਗਰੀਬ ਸਚੁ ਟੇਕ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai gareeb sach tek too(n) mere satigur poore ||
lines.translation: You are the True Support of me, the poor mortal, O my Perfect True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਦਰਸਨੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: dekh tumhaaraa darasano meraa man dheere ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, my mind is encouraged. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ਕਾਜਿ ਨ ਕਿਤੈ ਗਨੋੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: raaj maal ja(n)jaal kaaj na kitai ganou ||
lines.translation: Royal powers, wealth, and worldly involvements are of no use at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਹੁ ਧਨੋੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har keeratan aadhaar nihachal ehu dhanou ||2||
lines.translation: The Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is my Support; this wealth is everlasting. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਤੇਤ ਪਛਾਵਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jete maaiaa ra(n)g tet pachhaaviaa ||
lines.translation: As many as are the pleasures of Maya, so many are the shadows they leave.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sukh kaa naam nidhaan guramukh gaaviaa ||3||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs sing of the Naam, the treasure of peace. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa gunee nidhaan too(n) prabh gahir ga(n)bheere ||
lines.translation: You are the True Lord, the treasure of excellence; O God, You are deep and unfathomable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਭਰੋਸਾ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਜੀਅਰੇ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: aas bharosaa khasam kaa naanak ke jeeare ||4||9||111||
lines.translation: The Lord Master is the hope and support of Nanak's mind. ||4||9||111||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis simarat dukh jaai sahaj sukh paaeeai ||
lines.translation: Remembering Him, suffering is removed, and celestial peace is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: rain dinas kar joR har har dhiaaeeai ||1||
lines.translation: Night and day, with your palms pressed together, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kaa prabh soi jis kaa sabh koi ||
lines.translation: He alone is Nanak's God, unto whom all beings belong.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab rahiaa bharapoor sachaa sach soi ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He is totally pervading everywhere, the Truest of the True. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਗਿਆਨ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar baahar sa(n)g sahaaee giaan jog ||
lines.translation: Inwardly and outwardly, He is my companion and my helper; He is the One to be realized.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਮਨਾ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਸਗਲ ਰੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tisahi araadh manaa binaasai sagal rog ||2||
lines.translation: Adoring Him, my mind is cured of all its ailments. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: raakhanahaar apaar raakhai agan maahi ||
lines.translation: The Savior Lord is infinite; He saves us from the fire of the womb.
